name: io.github.tonydzi/sqlite-graph-memory
title: sqlite-graph-memory
description: Recall over your markdown notes: vector search plus your [[wikilinks]] as a graph, in SQLite.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: Recall needs the embedding and reranker models; [lite] runs them on ONNX Runtime without torch.

runtimeArguments.name: --python
runtimeArguments.description: Intel Macs have no onnxruntime wheels for Python 3.14, so without this pin uvx cannot resolve the package there.

environmentVariables.name: BRAIN_INDEX_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the index. Build it once with `sgm-index /path/to/notes`.
